name: Úlairë Nertëa
subtitle: Winged Hunter
game_text: When you play Úlairë Nertëa, spot another Nazgûl to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
flavor_text: “A vast winged shape passed over the moon like a black cloud… The stars fainted before it….”
